numeric_candidates.requirements: Nested prior-week selection, then untouched future weeks; improve both MAE/RMSE and prospective Top5 return against ATS research baseline.

numeric_candidates.evidence: Actual high-scoring misses include ordinary-volume but extreme-efficiency games, so a tempo-only correction is insufficient.

numeric_candidates.parameters: Recent 3-game and season-to-date drive rates with predeclared 0.25/0.50 recent weights; possessions times opponent-adjusted points/drive.
numeric_candidates.requirements: Archive genuine pregame drive/play data, QB/OL status and missingness; never backfill from target-game plays.
